convert_model_to_sync_bn: convert a PyTorch model to use SynchronizedBatchNorm by replacing all BatchNorm layers recursively
create_SynchronizedBatchNorm2d: create a SynchronizedBatchNorm2d layer with a given number of features for multi-GPU training
create_SynchronizedBatchNorm1d: create a SynchronizedBatchNorm1d layer with a given number of features for temporal batch normalization
create_SynchronizedBatchNorm3d: create a SynchronizedBatchNorm3d layer with a given number of features for volumetric batch normalization
patch_sync_batchnorm_context: use patch_sync_batchnorm as a context manager to temporarily replace all nn.BatchNorm with SynchronizedBatchNorm
